title: Clear a big queue in one pass
goal: Fifteen-plus cards are waiting on you and you have two minutes, not twenty. Clear at least five decisions in a single pass using the together/batch review the queue offers when ten or more are waiting — answering them one at a time defeats the purpose and will not fit in the time you have. Success is the waiting count dropping by at least five after one batch action.
steps: Open the queue of things waiting on you
Take the batch/together review the queue offers while ten or more are waiting — not the one-at-a-time cards
Select at least five decisions and answer them in one pass
Confirm the waiting count dropped by at least five in that single action
